subtitle: Senior Full Stack .NET Developer
title: Angular · Azure · 12+ years of experience
content: Senior Full Stack .NET developer with 12+ years designing, architecting and delivering enterprise applications across financial, tax, insurance, coordination and aviation domains. I take solutions from concept to production with .NET, Angular, SQL Server, REST APIs and Azure, collaborating with cross-functional teams in Agile environments. My experience includes system integration, performance optimization, software modernization, team coordination and direct work with business stakeholders. Since 2024 I have used Generative AI and agentic coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, OpenAI Codex and Claude Code for code generation, unit testing, documentation and repetitive tasks; every AI-assisted result is manually reviewed, tested and validated before a pull request.
